title: Quantum Hall Effect
description: Electrons in a sheet at low temperature and strong field fill Landau levels; the Hall resistance locks onto plateaus at h/(νe²), exact to a part in a billion - because it counts a topological invariant. Unlocks Hall Bar Chips.

puzzle.goal: With ν Landau levels filled, a sheet of electrons carries a Hall resistance R fixed only by the quantum of action h and the elementary charge q. Write R.
puzzle.name: Von Klitzing constant
puzzle.ask: Find R in ohms for the first plateau, n = @{n} (h = 6.626e-34 J·s, q = 1.602e-19 C).
puzzle.method: Each filled level carries a conductance of exactly q²/h, a topological (Chern) number times the quantum of conductance.
